# ConfettiController

> Burst of confetti particles from an element. DOM-based particles with randomized trajectories + gravity.

## Constructor

```ts
new ConfettiController(host: HTMLElement, options?: ConfettiOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `count` | `number` | no | Number of particles (default 30) |
| `spread` | `number` | no | Spread angle in degrees (default 90) |
| `velocity` | `number` | no | Initial velocity in px/frame (default 12) |
| `gravity` | `number` | no | Gravity in px/frame² (default 0.5) |
| `size` | `[number, number]` | no | Particle size range [min, max] in px (default [6, 10]) |
| `colors` | `string[]` | no | Colors array (default: rainbow) |
| `duration` | `number` | no | Duration before cleanup in ms (default 2000) |
| `trigger` | `'click' | 'manual'` | no | Trigger: 'click' | 'manual' (default 'click') |
| `shapes` | `'square' | 'circle' | 'mixed'` | no | Particle shapes: 'square' | 'circle' | 'mixed' (default 'mixed') |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disable the controller |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|----------|------|----------|
| `active` | `boolean` | yes |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:confetti` | `{ count, origin, y }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |
| `fire()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { ConfettiController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ConfettiController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
